subtitle: Lesson 11 · Distributions

code:
from scipy import stats
b = stats.binom(10, 0.3)
b.pmf(3)   # 0.2668  exactly 3
b.cdf(3)   # 0.6496  3 or fewer
b.sf(4)    # 0.1503  5 or more
caption: pmf is exactly k, cdf is k or fewer, sf is more than k.

code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
sim = rng.binomial(10, 0.3,
                   size=100_000)
(sim == 3).mean()   # 0.2679
caption: Simulation 0.2679 vs exact 0.2668: close, never identical.

code:
p = stats.poisson(4)
p.pmf(0)   # 0.0183  a silent hour
p.pmf(4)   # 0.1954
p.sf(7)    # 0.0511  8 or more
p.var()    # 4.0  mean == variance
caption: Variance far above the mean means Poisson is wrong.
